x: Botwright made good use of his liberal mark to win, with Eddie Pack doing inside 50 seconds to gain second place. R.

Alby Bird was an easy winner of the 880 yards in what was rather slow time, but here we lacked a second runner and so lost a chance of picking up useful points. The 1 Mile saw the two Belgrave men, R.
Calvert (A.A.), Frank Elston (R.A.O.C.), W. Hewitt (R.A.M.C.), R.
Was very impressed by Dick Towndrows' win in the M'Connell Cup Race. Michael (R. G.), R.N.—After a course of instruction on a dry land ship on the South Coast, has since gained a Commission.
This is Len's fastest 2 miles to-date, despite the fact that he wrote Carter he had done 8.53 at Bradford. " Mike," otherwise R.
